caption:
Six little scenes from the Amalfi Coast that make you want to book a window seat. 🍋🇮🇹

📍 Positano — pastel houses tumbling down the hillside.
📍 Ravello — gardens with views stretching to the sea.
📍 Amalfi — sunny afternoons among the beach umbrellas.
📍 Ravello — old stone lanes made for wandering.
📍 Path of the Gods — incredible views across the coast.
📍 Amalfi — watch the boats drift along the coast.

Save this for your next Italian escape.

Photos: Ian Mackey, nella n., Margo Evardson, Emran Yousof, Sekwang Chia & Barbora Dostálová / Unsplash.
